title: Just Because We Camp, Doesn’t Mean We Should: The Ethics of Modelling Queer Voices.
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on the modeling of queer voices and the associated ethical implications.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
